decisions.quote: To summarize our results, we were unable to replicate the main effect of Kanai et al. (2012) : anodal tDCS did not decrease the latency of contralateral prosaccades.
decisions.reason: The central finding the replication was designed and hypothesized to test was Kanai et al.'s (2012) main effect on contralateral prosaccade latency, which failed to replicate; saccade accuracy was an exploratory measure on which no effect was expected or hypothesized. The authors frame their study throughout as an unsuccessful replication with discrepant null results rather than as mixed support.
